title: AMZN Stock Soars 12% in Pre-Market Trading After Blowout Q2 Results as Analyst Says Amazon Is Already 'Monetizing' Its AI Investments
excerpt: Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ:AMZN) shares surged over 12% in Friday’s pre-market trading after the e-commerce and cloud-computing giant reported stronger-than-ex...
content_html:
Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ:AMZN) shares surged over 12% in Friday's pre-market trading after the e-commerce and cloud-computing giant reported stronger-than-expected second-quarter results.

Amazon Beats Revenue and Earnings Estimates

Amazon reported second-quarter revenue of $200.61 billion, exceeding Wall Street's consensus estimate of $196.46 billion. The company posted earnings of $5.75 per share, well above analysts' expectations of $1.82 per share.

Amazon's cloud division, Amazon Web Services, generated $42.2 billion in revenue, representing 36.7% year-over-year growth. The company said AWS recorded its fastest growth rate in 18 quarters.

Amazon also said its AI and custom-chip businesses had each surpassed annualized revenue run rates exceeding $25 billion, highlighting the growing commercial impact of its investments in artificial intelligence infrastructure.

Read Also:Amazon Already Knows What 2028 Looks Like: CEO Andy Jassy Says the Demand Is 'Striking' as AWS Races to Add Capacity

Chris Ballard Calls AWS Amazon's 'Crown Jewel'

In an emailed statement to Benzinga, Chris Ballard, managing director at Check Capital Management, described the results as "an emphatic answer to skepticism," pointing to the sharp acceleration in AWS growth.

"The headline story is the dramatic reacceleration of Amazon Web Services," Ballard said, calling AWS Amazon's "crown jewel" and adding that he was "very happy" with its performance.

Ballard said Amazon's substantial infrastructure spending is increasingly translating into revenue growth rather than remaining solely a long-term investment.

"Amazon isn't just spending on AI for tomorrow — it is monetizing it today," he said.

Advertising and Operating Profit Add to Amazon's Strength

Amazon's total operating income climbed 43% to $27.5 billion, while its high-margin advertising business grew 26%, providing additional support for profitability.

Looking ahead, Amazon forecasts third-quarter revenue of $197 billion to $202 billion, below analysts' estimate of $204.08 billion. The company expects operating income of $22.5 billion to $26.5 billion, compared with $17.4 billion in the year-ago quarter.

Price Action: In pre-market trading on Friday, Amazon shares rose 11.34% to $262.20, according to Benzinga Pro.

Benzinga Edge Rankings place Amazon in the 95th percentile for Growth, although the stock continues to show a negative price trend across the short-, medium- and long-term time frames.

content_html_zh:
电子商务和云计算巨头亚马逊公司（纳斯达克股票代码：AMZN）公布强于预期的第二季度业绩后，该公司股价在周五盘前交易中飙升超过 12%。

亚马逊的收入和盈利超出预期

亚马逊公布第二季度营收为 2006.1 亿美元，超过华尔街普遍预期的 1964.6 亿美元。 该公司公布每股收益 5.75 美元，远高于分析师预期的每股 1.82 美元。

亚马逊的云部门亚马逊网络服务创造了 422 亿美元的收入，同比增长 36.7%。 该公司表示，AWS 创下了 18 个季度以来最快的增长率。

亚马逊还表示，其人工智能和定制芯片业务的年化收入均已超过 250 亿美元，突显其人工智能基础设施投资日益增长的商业影响。

另请阅读：亚马逊已经知道 2028 年会是什么样子：首席执行官安迪·贾西 (Andy Jassy) 表示，随着 AWS 竞相增加容量，需求“惊人”

Chris Ballard 称 AWS 为亚马逊的“皇冠上的明珠”

Check Capital Management 董事总经理 Chris Ballard 在发给 Benzinga 的电子邮件声明中将这一结果描述为“对怀疑的有力回答”，并指出 AWS 增长的急剧加速。

巴拉德表示：“头条新闻是亚马逊网络服务的戏剧性重新加速。”他称 AWS 是亚马逊的“皇冠上的明珠”，并补充说他对其表现“非常满意”。

巴拉德表示，亚马逊大量的基础设施支出正日益转化为收入增长，而不仅仅是一项长期投资。

他说：“亚马逊不仅在明天的人工智能上投入资金，而且在今天将其货币化。”

广告和运营利润增强了亚马逊的实力

亚马逊总营业收入增长43%，达到275亿美元，而高利润的广告业务增长26%，为盈利能力提供了额外支持。

展望未来，亚马逊预计第三季度营收为 1970 亿美元至 2020 亿美元，低于分析师预期的 2040.8 亿美元。 该公司预计营业收入为 225 亿美元至 265 亿美元，而去年同期为 174 亿美元。

价格走势：根据 Benzinga Pro 的数据，在周五的盘前交易中，亚马逊股价上涨 11.34% 至 262.20 美元。

Benzinga Edge Rankings 将亚马逊的增长排名排在第 95%，尽管该股在短期、中期和长期时间范围内继续呈现出负面的价格趋势。
